about_the_game: Hired to take down a notorious faction leader you wander into the Asran Exclusion Zone. You will have to survive hunger, thirst, dangerous factions, radioactive emissions and the wild life. Remember, this is no man's home and you are not the hero.

name: No Man's Home Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10-11
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100/AMD Ryzen 5 1400 or higher
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1000 series or equivalent or higher
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10-11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600x or higher
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060/AMD RX 580 or higher
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
